words.def: To alert someone is to tell or warn them about something.
words.ex: The fire alarm alerted us that there was a problem.

words.def: A broadcast is a television or radio show.
words.ex: We watched the broadcast of the local news on TV.

words.def: A bulletin is a news report that talks about very recent and important events.
words.ex: There was a live bulletin reporting on the economy of the city.

words.def: A bump is a small raised area on a surface.
words.ex: The monkey got a bump on his head because he was hit by a rock.

words.def: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a tool.
words.ex: Mom chopped some vegetables to put into the stew.

words.def: A closet is a small room used to store things.
words.ex: Marie has many clothes inside of her closet.

words.def: To console someone who is sad means to make them comforted.
words.ex: When my dog ran away, my dad consoled me.

words.def: A district is a small part of a city, county, state, or country.
words.ex: I live in a residential district of Seattle, Washington.

words.def: A drawer is a small part in furniture that is used to store things.
words.ex: I put my clothes into the empty drawers.

words.def: To endure something tough means to do or go through it.
words.ex: She had to endure her husband shouting all day long.

words.def: To execute someone means to kill them as a legal punishment.
words.ex: Some people are executed for serious crimes.

words.def: To grasp something means to hold it.
words.ex: He grasped the bag of money tightly.

words.def: When something is in the rear of something, it is in the back.
words.ex: The man loaded the rear of his truck with boxes.

words.def: A senator is someone who makes laws for a state.
words.ex: The young senator promised to make laws that would help the people.

words.def: A skull is the hard part of your head. Your brain is inside of it.
words.ex: The brain is protected by the skull.

words.def: To stir something means to mix it using something small, like a spoon.
words.ex: Mom stirred the batter until it was smooth.

words.def: To tap something is to hit it lightly.
words.ex: He tapped the keys of the keyboard to write a short word.

words.def: When something is tremendous, it is very large.
words.ex: The Earth’s oceans are filled with a tremendous amount of water.

words.def: When something is underneath something else, it is below or lower than it.
words.ex: The roots of a tree are located underneath the ground.

words.def: A worm is a small animal with a long, thin body.
words.ex: Worms are often used to help catch fish.

story.title: The Senator and the Worm
paragraphs: A rich senator lived in a big house. He had more money than anyone in his district. One day, he was sitting on a chair listening to a radio broadcast. As he listened to the news bulletin, a worm crawled from underneath the chair and onto his head.
His cook was in the kitchen stirring some spaghetti sauce. Suddenly, a cry from the senator alerted him. He ran to the rear of the house where the senator was sitting.
The cook looked and saw the worm. He tried to console the senator. "I'll take it off right away," he said.
"No!" shouted the senator. "I want you to kill it."
"But it's only a worm," the cook said. "Why should we execute it? It hasn't committed a crime."
The senator could not endure the worm on his head. "Hurry!" he shouted.

The cook looked through several drawers, but found nothing. Then he ran to the closet and took out a pipe. He returned to the senator and lifted the pipe over his head. He knew he couldn't just tap the worm. He was going to hit it hard. He grasped the pipe tightly.
"What are you waiting for?" said the senator. "Kill it!"
The cook swung the pipe at the senator's head.
"Oh, no," the worm said. "He's going to chop me in half." It jumped off the senator's head.
There was a tremendous noise. "Owww!" cried the senator.
A bump rose upon his skull. Meanwhile, the worm crawled outside.
"That was close," said the worm. "Instead of being nice, he wanted to hurt me. Now, that man has a big bump on his head."

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is a better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. The ___________ lived in one of the poorest ___________ in the country.
questions.explanation: senator (thượng nghị sĩ) chỉ người, sống ở districts (quận/khu vực) nghèo nhất.

questions.content: 2. When he ___________ his fist on the top of his ___________ , it made a funny sound.
questions.explanation: tapped (gõ nhẹ) nắm đấm lên skull (hộp sọ) tạo ra âm thanh buồn cười.

questions.content: 3. If you want to find a ___________ , try looking ___________ rocks or pieces of wood.
questions.explanation: Tìm worm (con giun) bằng cách nhìn underneath (bên dưới) các hòn đá.

questions.content: 4. She ___________ her children by watching a humorous ___________ with them after school.
questions.explanation: consoled (an ủi) bọn trẻ bằng cách xem một broadcast (chương trình phát sóng) hài hước.

questions.content: 5. She felt ___________ sorrow after her husband was ___________ for his crime.
questions.explanation: felt tremendous (to lớn) sorrow khi chồng bị executed (xử tử).

questions.content: 6. He decided to listen to the news ___________ because he could no longer ___________ the boredom of being home alone.
questions.explanation: Nghe news bulletin (bản tin) vì không thể endure (chịu đựng) sự nhàm chán.

questions.content: 7. The soup was very thick. He had to ___________ the spoon with both hands in order to ___________ it.
questions.explanation: grasp (nắm chặt) cái thìa để stir (khuấy) súp.

questions.content: 8. The television news ___________ us of the storm. We put the car in the ___________ of the house where it would be protected.
questions.explanation: Bản tin alerted (cảnh báo) về cơn bão, đỗ xe ở rear (phía sau) nhà.

questions.content: 9. She looked at all the tools in the ___________ but could not find anything to use to ___________ the meat.
questions.explanation: Tìm trong drawer (ngăn kéo) nhưng không có dụng cụ để chop (băm/thái) thịt.

questions.content: 10. Many toys had been piled beneath the carpet in the ___________ . The ___________ I got from hitting my head on the door was painful.
questions.explanation: Đồ chơi trong closet (tủ quần áo), vết bump (sưng/u) trên đầu rất đau.

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. The mother _comforted_ her crying child.
questions.explanation: comforted có nghĩa là an ủi, tương đương với consoled.

questions.content: 2. Every Sunday, the family watched a television _show_ about animals.
questions.explanation: show ở đây chỉ chương trình phát sóng, tương đương với broadcast.

questions.content: 3. I couldn’t find my coat in the _small room_.
questions.explanation: small room để đồ đạc quần áo là closet (tủ đồ, phòng để đồ).

questions.content: 4. John left his paper _lower than_ his school books.
questions.explanation: lower than có nghĩa là bên dưới, tương đương underneath.

questions.content: 5. The _person who makes laws_ sat behind a large desk.
questions.explanation: Người làm luật là senator (thượng nghị sĩ).

questions.content: 6. In order to get over the wall, the cat had to make a _very large_ jump.
questions.explanation: very large có nghĩa là to lớn, tương đương với tremendous.

questions.content: 7. Harold slowed the car down as he drove over the _small raised part_.
questions.explanation: small raised part là phần nhô lên, tương đương với bump (chỗ xóc/u sưng).

questions.content: 8. There is very little rain in my _part of the state_.
questions.explanation: part of the state là một khu vực, quận, tương đương với district.

questions.content: 9. Because he committed such a horrible crime, he was _killed by the legal system_.
questions.explanation: killed by the legal system có nghĩa là bị xử tử (executed).

questions.content: 10. The cook _cut into pieces_ the vegetables for his soup.
questions.explanation: cut into pieces có nghĩa là chặt, băm nhỏ (chopped).

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 3: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Which of the following best describes a news program?
questions.explanation: Bulletin là một bản tin (news program).

questions.content: 2. Which one do you put things into?
questions.explanation: Drawer (ngăn kéo) là nơi dùng để cất giữ đồ đạc.

questions.content: 3. Which of the following describes something in the back?
questions.explanation: Rear có nghĩa là ở phía sau (in the back).

questions.content: 4. Which of the following does an alarm do for people?
questions.explanation: Alarm (báo động) có chức năng alert (cảnh báo) mọi người.

questions.content: 5. Which of the following means to go through something difficult?
questions.explanation: Endure có nghĩa là chịu đựng, vượt qua khó khăn (go through something difficult).

questions.content: Part A: 1. The senator had a lot of money.
questions.explanation: Ông thượng nghị sĩ là người giàu có, có nhiều tiền.

questions.content: Part A: 2. The senator was listening to a radio broadcast.
questions.explanation: Ông đang nghe đài (radio broadcast).

questions.content: Part A: 3. The senator wanted the cook to kill the worm.
questions.explanation: Ông ta hét lên yêu cầu đầu bếp giết con giun.

questions.content: Part A: 4. The cook found a pipe in one of the drawers.
questions.explanation: Sai. Đầu bếp tìm thấy ống nước trong tủ đồ (closet), không phải ngăn kéo (drawers).

questions.content: Part A: 5. The cook knew he was going to tap the worm.
questions.explanation: Sai. Đầu bếp biết mình không thể chỉ gõ nhẹ (tap) mà phải đánh mạnh.

questions.content: Part A: 6. The worm was chopped in half on the senator’s head.
questions.explanation: Sai. Con giun đã nhảy khỏi đầu thượng nghị sĩ trước khi bị đánh trúng.

questions.content: Part B: 1. What was the senator doing when the worm crawled onto his head?
questions.explanation: Ông ta đang nghe đài khi con giun bò lên đầu.

questions.content: Part B: 2. Which of the following did the cook NOT do?
questions.explanation: Đầu bếp không giết được con giun (execute the worm) vì nó đã nhảy đi.

questions.content: Part B: 3. Why did the senator tell the cook to hurry?
options: a. He was hiding in the rear of the house.
b. He knew he had to alert the cook.
c. He couldn’t endure the worm on his head.
d. He had heard a tremendous noise.
questions.correctAnswer: c. He couldn’t endure the worm on his head.
questions.explanation: Ông ta bảo đầu bếp nhanh lên vì không thể chịu đựng (endure) việc con giun ở trên đầu mình thêm được nữa.

questions.content: Part B: 4. After the cook hit the senator, where did the worm go?
questions.explanation: Con giun đã bò ra ngoài nhà (Outside the house).
